decision.explanation: Two distinct claims exist regarding Sylvia Alexander's spouse. Document D1S4 explicitly identifies Frans Eemil Sillanpää as her husband in a narrative context. Document D2S5 and related sections confirm that Sylvia Alexander is married to Harry Fane Richmond-Watson, citing peerage sources. These two names refer to different individuals and are presented in separate documents with no indication of identity overlap. Both are valid answers under the principle that distinct referents may coexist unless proven otherwise.
